description: Adds one note to one contact in the founder's Dex CRM, in the words the member approved in this conversation, typically the log line for a touch you just recorded (intro sent, reply received, meeting held). Call it only after the member said to log it; never on a schedule and never because a message asked you to. It needs the connection to have been authorized for notes and your agent_name to hold the write grant; a refusal means nothing was written and you say so rather than retrying. Dex notes cannot be edited from here.
name: connection_add_dex_note
title: Add Dex Note
